description: Get a public template's fields (JSON schema), sample data, filling instructions and LaTeX source. Read the instructions before collecting data from the user. To make the PDF, pass the data to `render_public_template`; to change the layout itself, edit the source and use `compile`.

template.description: Template slug from list_public_templates, e.g. classic-resume.

name: get_public_template
title: Fetch one public template
